0.description: [Follow Up Changelog]: With the Hasty RE rework it will also cause abilities like Demolisher and abilities transformed from other abilities to always work & update said tooltip and function with addons.
Drastically reduced the base spawn timer of some mobs required for Felforged Quests from 15 minutes to 5 minutes.

Polished and thoroughly spreaded density of mobs (where some hidden areas were super dense with mobs) to make some popular areas in Felforged more dense in mobs for quests, so you know you can find action.
Added Dynamic Respawning to ALL mobs required in Felforged Quests.
Fixed an issue where Missile Barrage (random enchantment) would desync and no longer increase the chance to proc Missile Barrage through Starfire & Moonfire.
Fixed an issue where Decimation (under certain circumstances) would fail to benefit from Backdraft & Decimation cast time & global cooldown reduction simultaneously.

Fixed an issue in the spell priority que system for Maelstrom Weapon. 

Maelstrom weapon would consume other cast time buffs (such as Flame Throwing and Flash Freeze) when casted through 5 stacks of maelstrom weapon for their respective elements. 

Additionally, when you have 4 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon, the cast time modifiers from Flame Throwing and Flash Freeze will stack to Maelstrom Weapons cast time modifier making the spell cast instant.

The Scarab Lord Quest Chain will no longer reset on Prestige. 

Your quest log will still be cleared, but you can now go to the quest giver for the quest that you were previously on to continue your progress right where you left off.

[Pending Restart] Reworked all "Hasty" Random Enchantments and removed the old implementation. 

The new implementation will allow for these Random Enchantments to properly update the tooltip & also allow addons to show the reduced cooldown reduction (weakauras) etc.

This change has been live for relatively 36 hours but seemed to have gone missing from our changelog. 

[Alar] Fixed an issue in draft logic that caused talented abilities such as Blessing of Sanctuary far too often. Overall this logic switch should cause other talented abilities to show up more often.
[Requires Launcher Update] Fixed an issue where certain passwords would fail to save properly on the login screen. Saved login screen passwords should now always work.

[Requires Launcher Update] The totem bar is now visible even when you have stances or forms learned.

3.description: All pages not mentioned above were also part of the mobile rework. (But in order to keep this changelog *relatively short*, they were excluded.)
Highlights: Reworked view for order history to only contain the necessary information that we frequently request in order to assist with tickets while on the go.
Highlights: Updated landing page design to match the desktop equivalent.
Highlights: Reworked the UCP so that all data is properly viewable and editable. Also increased touch-zones for elements that were hard to accurately hit previously.
Highlights: Swapped positioning of certain frequently used header elements to be easier to reach for right-handed people. (Left-handed option will be available soon.)
Highlights: Shop items now properly support animatated image/video formats.
Highlights: Reworked realm selection/shop browsing/item viewing/cart.
Highlights: Brand new design for viewing characters + mail on mobile.
Highlights: Separate view for news articles to take better advantage of the aspect ratio.
Highlights: Entirely replaced the old navigation menus on both the landing, ucp and leaderboard.

Pushed a massive rewrite for the mobile version of the site to bring the experience up to par to the desktop equivalent. The website team will be extra vigilent in monitoring the Bugtracker over the next couple weeks to catch any issues that might have slipped past due to the size of the update.
Added the ability to view archived mails for each of your characters under the "My Characters -> View Mail Inbox" button on the UCP.
Replaced the hover animation for shop items with a more performant and less buggy solution.
Minor adjustments to the contrast and spacing of text elements in news articles to reduce eye-strain.

6.description: Extension regarding Fierce Blow changes: Creatures that have a magic damage school instead of physical damage on their auto attacks have a much lower base damage then the classic physical damaging creature to account the damage reduction from armor being missing. However this creatures also use Fierce Blow. Since the base damage of this creatures is reduced, their Fierce Blows dealt much less damage then the once from physical damaging creatures as their Fierce Blows are still getting reduced by armor and reduced this creatures overall damage rather then keeping it constant. With recent changes to Fierce Blow inheriting the creatures spell school, the damage will now be equal to this creatures auto attacks. This insures that Fierce Blow still serves its purpose of supressing high avoidance stacking builds and allowing a creature to not have all of its damage be nullified by extreme parry and dodge values for creatures that use a different spell school as physical.
